Product Title:
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

Short Marketing Description:
Stay connected, active, and in control with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch. Designed for everyday performance, it combines a vivid AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, and essential health and fitness tracking in a sleek, durable design.

Key Features:
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for clear, vibrant viewing
- Bluetooth calling for convenient communication on the go
- Up to 7-day battery life for reliable daily use
- Heart-rate monitoring to support wellness tracking
- Sleep tracking for better recovery insights
- Fitness activity tracking for everyday movement and workouts
- IP68 waterproof rating for added durability

Promotional Tagline:
Smart tracking. Seamless living.
